reviewer: Codex agent visual review; owner design approval pending

overall.observedProblem: The character remains a working stylized avatar with simple secondary forms.
overall.visualConsequence: It is visibly below the intended premium anime target.
overall.recommendedAction: Continue localized source refinement; do not export or animate.

silhouette.observedProblem: Adult proportions and the simple utility-outfit silhouette remain readable.
silhouette.visualConsequence: The earlier proportion correction survives the local face edits.
silhouette.recommendedAction: Preserve proportions while refining component forms.

face.location: Portrait three-quarter, high/low and matcap evidence
face.observedProblem: Cheek volume is restrained but insufficiently structured; skin lid rims and ears remain primitive.
face.visualConsequence: The face lacks nuanced plane transitions and anatomy.
face.recommendedAction: Refine upper/lower skin rims, cheek-to-jaw transitions and ear structure locally.

eyes.location: Eye close-up and both portrait three-quarters
eyes.observedProblem: Outer sclera seating and upper lash continuity improved, but lids are still graphic ribbons and cornea is absent.
eyes.visualConsequence: The eye opening reads cleaner but lacks modeled depth and skin thickness.
eyes.recommendedAction: Build/refine skin lid rims and socket transitions without regenerating the character.

profile.observedProblem: Nose, lips and chin remain a simplified sequence of bumps; the mouth line is an attached patch.
profile.visualConsequence: The profile reads less deliberately authored than the front.
profile.recommendedAction: Restrain the mouth shelf, shape the nasal underside and reconcile chin/jaw projection.

hair.observedProblem: Locks remain broad repeated strip-like masses with limited designed overlap.
hair.visualConsequence: The silhouette and highlights still reveal procedural construction.
hair.recommendedAction: Art-direct important fringe/temple clumps individually after face forms improve.

anatomy.observedProblem: Covered anatomy is not yet a reviewed body source; sleeve shoulder transitions are broad and angular.
anatomy.visualConsequence: Clothing hides unresolved anatomical and silhouette relationships.
anatomy.recommendedAction: Develop shoulder and garment masses before rigging or tiny detail.

clothing.observedProblem: Collar and pockets are present but jacket/sleeve forms are broad with limited fold hierarchy.
clothing.visualConsequence: Outfit construction lacks premium secondary shape design.
clothing.recommendedAction: Refine collar and upper-body fold groups once facial blockers are resolved.

hands.observedProblem: Palm and digits remain simple separate components without reviewed webbing/deformation.
hands.visualConsequence: The visible hand lacks intentional anatomical plane structure.
hands.recommendedAction: Use isolated component replacement/sculpting before later topology and rig review.

materials.observedProblem: Dedicated face material fixes the shared-mask error, but skin and cloth remain extremely flat.
materials.visualConsequence: Modeled forms are poorly supported by material separation and painted design.
materials.recommendedAction: Paint intentional localized masks and color decisions with visual feedback.

shader.location: Source-lookdev 13-angle sweep and current light views
shader.observedProblem: The head-relative SDF transition is stable but generic; hair bands are too uniform and neutral face shading is flat.
shader.visualConsequence: The look-development foundation works but is not a finished anime shader look.
shader.recommendedAction: Tune facial masks and hair highlights under the full sweep after form correction.

deformation.observedProblem: No approved source deformation rig is active.
deformation.visualConsequence: No deformation or animation quality can be claimed.
deformation.recommendedAction: Defer rigging and animation until static source quality passes.

topThree.location: Upper/lower skin rims and outer corners
topThree.problem: Eyelids remain graphic ribbons despite improved seating.
topThree.consequence: Eyes lack modeled skin thickness and socket integration.
topThree.correction: Select lids, add/refine continuous skin rims locally and inspect all portrait angles.

topThree.problem: The profile has a simplified mouth shelf and weakly reconciled chin/jaw shape.
topThree.consequence: Secondary profile structure remains below target.
topThree.correction: Use broad, small profile strokes and reject isolated bumps; compare front and low three-quarter.

topThree.problem: Cheek transitions are generic and the ear is a traced loop.
topThree.consequence: Large facial areas lack designed secondary forms.
topThree.correction: Refine cheek planes, then rebuild the ear component alone using original authored topology.

comparison.observations: Artist cycles rejected a pointed screen-space chin stroke, accepted a smaller bilateral correction, partially retained eye depth seating and repaired upper lash continuity. Cheek and shader revisions remain working partial changes. Comparisons are in review/artist/history.json; the current full pack has corrected eye framing. Local improvements do not pass the global face stage.
